sentences.jp: 彼は紙コップを軽く掲げ、制御室の方へ歩き去った。

sentences.en: He lightly raised the paper cup and walked away toward the control room.

sentences.ruby: 背中はいつもどおりまっすぐで、足取りも乱れていなかった。
sentences.en: His back was straight as usual, and his steps were steady.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.jp: ただ、その肩のどこかに、長年積み重ねてきたものを少しずつ下ろし始めた人間の気配が、確かに漂っていた。

sentences.en: However, there was definitely a presence of someone who had begun to gradually let go of the burdens they had carried for many years, lingering somewhere on that shoulder.

sentences.en: Nothing has ended with the meeting with Inspector Sone.

sentences.jp: むしろ、これから始まる長い検証作業の入口に、ようやく自分の名前で立ったというだけだった。

sentences.en: During the lunch break, he went out to the outdoor area and sent a brief message to his aunt Yumi.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.jp: 「今朝、曽根さんに生データを見せた。橘さんとも、廊下で少しだけ話した。夜、寄ってもいいですか。」

sentences.en: "This morning, I showed the raw data to Inspector Sone. I also had a brief conversation with Senior Engineer Tachibana in the hallway. Is it okay if I stop by tonight?"
